units.i2v_prompt: Single continuous take at 24fps, 16:9. A close-up at eye level; the camera travels alongside the subject at the subject's own pace, easing with each step and settling when the subject stills. A white paper plane flashing up off a rooftop into the dusk sky, the hand still open in its follow-through, the water tower sliding past below. Warm 2000 Taiwanese telecine grade, warm skin tones, milky lifted blacks. Visible 35mm film grain. Restrained continuous motion, camera and subject motion only.
